title: Where cancer's changes come from
body: Genes are instructions inside each cell. Cancer is caused by changes to genes that control how cells grow and divide.
Some gene changes are passed down from a parent. Others happen during a person's life.
Changes during life can come from things in the environment. They can also come from errors when cells divide.
Only about 5 to 10 percent of cancers are caused by harmful gene changes passed down from a parent.
The other 90 to 95 percent come from changes during a person's lifetime. These come with ageing and from things like tobacco smoke and radiation.
No one chooses the genes they are born with. A change from birth is nobody's fault.
realWorld: This is why protecting yourself, like using sun protection, matters for everyone.
